name: climbcliff-badge-control
description: docs 77 §5 cliff 1, CONTROL build: the field move APPENDED past the badge-mapped range, so CUT keeps enum 0 and is gated on the badge the player is holding.

probes.why: which arm the boot key selected. Assert that the thing under test happened, or a green run may be a run of something else.
FIELD_MOVE_CUT's value, read out of the ROM through CliffGetCutFieldMoveIndex rather than restated here.
THE WELD AS A NUMBER: FLAG_BADGE01_GET + FIELD_MOVE_CUT, which is the flag CursorCb_FieldMove will actually test.
the last movement action id handed to the VM.
how many of those were past the end of the table.
monotone frame counter. THE probe that separates 'the cliff did something' from 'the ROM never ran'.

assert.why: CUT is where it has always been.
SUPPORTING and deliberately weak: the flag id itself is printed for the record, but the claim lives in cut_index, which needs no copy of FLAG_BADGE01_GET's expression to check.
